description.value: Langley Farm Market is a Metro Vancouver chain specializing in freshly picked local produce sourced directly from BC farmers, including Okanagan fruit and organic Metro Vancouver vegetables. This Lougheed/Maple Ridge location offers a broad selection including fresh meat, deli cold cuts, chilled seafood, in-store baked goods, and natural and organic groceries. The market won the 2025 Vancouver Consumer Choice Award for Best Fruit & Vegetable Market, reflecting a strong reputation for freshness and quality.
